adjudication.rationale: In `Admin::EmbeddableHostsController#update`, the code does `host = EmbeddableHost.where(id: params[:id]).first` and then unconditionally calls `save_host(host)`. `save_host` immediately dereferences `host` (`host.host = ...`, `host.category_id = ...`), so if the record is missing/stale and `first` returns `nil`, this will raise `NoMethodError` and produce a 500 instead of a 404/handled error.
